**A.** The deposition is admissible as former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1), because the engineer is unavailable and the company's attorney had the opportunity to examine him under oath on the same safety-report and structural-defect issues. The main weakness is "similar motive": the company's motive in a wrongful-termination suit may differ from its motive in a products-liability case. I'd still answer A, since the falsity of the safety reports was central to both proceedings.

CONFIDENCE: 65
